label: Create new transaction
description: Creates new transaction and returns information

amount.description: Transaction amount. A positive value creates a credit transaction and a negative value creates a debit transaction (unless transactionType is explicitly provided).

transactionType.description: Explicit transaction type. If not provided, the type is inferred from the sign of the amount (positive = credit, negative = debit).

balanceDefinitionId.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the associated balance definition.

contactId.description: Unique identifier of the contact involved in the transaction. Required unless `LoyaltySubscriptionId` is provided.

LoyaltySubscriptionId.description: Unique identifier for the loyalty subscription. Required unless `contactId` is provided.

meta.description: Optional metadata associated with the transaction.

ttl.description: Time-to-live for the transaction in seconds. Must be at least 10 seconds if provided.

eventTime.description: Timestamp specifying when the transaction event occurred (ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 format).

autoComplete.description: Whether the transaction should be automatically completed.

balanceExpiryInMinutes.description: Expiry time for the balance in minutes. Must be greater than 0 if provided. Only applicable when autoComplete is true.

schema.description: Represents a transaction involving a balance, including status and timestamps.

balance.description: The contact's total balance for this balance definition after the transaction was applied. Only returned when the transaction actually updated the balance (i.e. it was completed or auto-completed).

meta.description: Optional metadata associated with the transaction.

status.description: The current status of the transaction.

loyaltyProgramId.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the associated loyalty program.

balanceDefinitionId.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the associated balance definition.

contactId.description: Unique identifier of the contact associated with the transaction.

eventTime.description: Optional timestamp indicating when the transaction event occurred (ISO 8601 format).

rejectReason.description: Reason for rejection if the transaction was declined (nullable).

rejectedAt.description: Timestamp when the transaction was rejected (nullable).

completedAt.description: Timestamp when the transaction was completed (nullable).

cancelledAt.description: Timestamp when the transaction was canceled (nullable).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the transaction was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the transaction was last updated.

preconditions: Loyalty app activated (needed before any call in this area)
